observations: A solid black animal silhouette bends its four narrow limbs toward a single black circle at the bottom, with its tail raised high and a light-blue outline around the body.
Two light-blue spiral eyes and a white zigzag tooth line stand out inside the black head.
Short dark-red wavy and angular lines scatter across the saturated yellow field around the silhouette.

Spiral eyes and bared zigzag teeth push the face toward something between comic and unsettling. The dark-red wave-lines packed across the yellow field press in from all sides, making the surrounding space feel charged rather than open.
